references.text: The Lord your God goes before you like a consuming fire and will destroy the nations before you, so that you may drive them out.
Joshua son of Nun, who stands before you, he shall enter there. Strengthen him, for he shall give Israel the land as their possession.
The Lord commissions Joshua to lead the people across the Jordan and into the land, just as promised.
Fulfillment of the promise that Joshua would lead the people across the Jordan and into the promised land.
Moses appoints Joshua as his successor by the Lord's command, confirming that Joshua would lead the people.
The angel of the Lord shall go before and bring Israel into the land and destroy the nations living there.
The Lord promises to drive out the nations before Israel when they enter the land.
Joshua is mentioned as the one who gave the people rest, a parallel to his role as leader into the promised land.
